title: Setting up, and refusing to overwrite
intro: init is the only command that runs before the .ai/ layer exists. It seeds the manifest, the policy, the profiles, the vendored rule baseline and the empty sections from the skeleton, and it never touches .ai/local/.

scenarios.title: A repository with no AI layer
scenarios.explain: The skeleton is copied in, the ignore line for .ai/local/ is added, and the two hook lines the policy needs are printed together with the command that will verify they were added. init does not install hooks itself.

scenarios.title: A repository that already has one
scenarios.explain: Exit 15 is REFUSED, not an error. Overwriting a policy someone has edited is the kind of silent loss this tool exists to prevent, so it stops and names the flag that adds without overwriting.

scenarios.title: Adding what is missing with --extend
scenarios.explain: --extend seeds only the files the layer lacks and rewrites nothing. On a complete layer it says so; the files under .ai/repo/ belong to the repository from the moment they were created.
